final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor offered no genuinely new admissible evidence. That clarification improves the framing, but it is still a reinterpretation of the same evidence, not new support. The rejection therefore remains suspicious rather than noncompliant, because a conservative unresolved-risk reading is plausible, but it is not adequately demonstrated from the admissible record provided to this role.
